notes.title: Early Access Version 1.5 - Hyper Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes:
• Delete is now a new mechanic:
     - Delete is a shop option if the item is a market item, if used it completely removes the item from the run 
     - Has 20% chance to be dropped by blue loot drones

https://i.ibb.co/WWVHN6P/Delete.gif

• Hyper mode is now available in the map selection screen which will increase game speed by 1.4x

https://i.ibb.co/Mh6DkpT/Hyper.gif

• Quick start is now an option in the main menu
     - Randomizes starting breacher, weapon and map
     - But retains map upgrades, map size/type, difficulty and if endless

https://i.ibb.co/wdc0TPP/Quick-Start.gif

• Level changes tint by a small value to introduce variation

Minor Changes:
• Time now slows down before leveling up to reduce mistakes
• When getting damaged it is the same as stomping both scale with radius and damage return stat
• Breacher no longer gets knocked back when damaged instead the enemy gets knockback'd
• All breachers start with 1 stomp to be the same with dash and jump
• Force stomp is now directly tied to stomp stat to limit spamming and make it a viable build
• Controller button remapping:
     - Melee mapped to RB/right bumper
     - Force stomp mapped to LT/left trigger
     - Zeta's Shop mapped to select button
     - Xol's shop mapped to LB/left bumper
     - Autofire mapped right analog button press
     - Breacher information mapped Left analog button press
• Charmed enemies now knockbacks other enemies
• Cade's Token is now dropped in DarkNet and Uria's Token is dropped in Firewall exclusively
• Changed energy cost of Ceramic Plate 3 -> 5 and Bandage 5 -> 3

Bug Fixes:
• Fixed invincible not working properly
• Fixed weapon menu navigation for controller/handheld users
• Fixed bug where reduced animation interferes with prop height
• Fixed charmed enemies just standing still

Happy breaching !
- AcidRain

notes.title: Early Access Version 1.4 - Movement Update
notes.notes:
Major Changes:

• Force stomp can now be used (Binded to Left Shift)
     - When stomping the ground it pushes back enemies
     - Trigger to stomp enemies faster but you will need stomp amount/damage return
     - Force stomp resets when hitting the ground/enemy

https://i.ibb.co/ZfK5ymm/Stomp.gif

• Weapon melee attack is now an option (Binded to F)
     - Melee damage is dependent on weapon's damage
     - Has sound effects for melee hit and swing
     - Melee speed is dependent on switch speed

https://i.ibb.co/GsspmDP/Melee.gif

• Weapon now rotates when jumping (makes jumping and shooting a more viable strategy)
• Both force stomp and melee scales with knockback and radius
• Shop cannot be accessed after 10-15 min in endless for balancing

Minor Changes:

• Changed Item: LAN Cable (15% switch speed -> 10% switch speed)
• Enemies now gets yeeted on death, yeet scales with knockback
• Shop discount stat is now capped at 60%
• Jump on air now has chance to trigger a unique flip animation
• Dash now has an animation and puff effect
• Dash now resets immediately after dashing even if you still have dashes
• Uria's token set back to 100
• Fixed errors when the game end and shows the "Breached" screen
• Presets were vaulted for now because it is causing major bugs 

Happy breaching !
- AcidRain

notes.title: Early Access Version 1.3
notes.notes:
Major Changes:
• Added breacher presets
     - Further customize your playstyle with 5 preset slots
     - Preset saves your current breacher, weapon and upgrades
     - Uria's token is now capped at 500 and is shared among the 5 presets
https://i.ibb.co/fxfqwVY/Preset.png

• Added 2 weapons
     - Half-life: Toxicthrower
     - Blue screen: Shrapnel launcher
https://i.ibb.co/Fm2hXBh/Blue-Screen.png
https://i.ibb.co/WDT6Wzy/Half-Life.png

• Added map size selector for random map type in level select screen
     -Enemy amount changes depending on the selected size of the map and difficulty
https://i.ibb.co/9ZfLLhy/Map-Size.png

• Added a dash stat and a respective upgrade

Minor Changes:
• Lowered enemy health to make vanilla much easier to finish
• Chest drop and loot drones now start at 10 seconds
• Character selection UI greyed-out when not unlocked
• Weapon selection UI greyed-out when not unlocked
• Added extra UI for jump, stomp and dash amount
• Reduced the dash speed to make dash item more viable
• Token drop rate now increases by difficulty
• Slightly adjusted token drop rate
• Fixed radius stat in upgrades now working correctly
• Shrapnel bullets now trigger when hitting enemies
• Smaller chain hitbox to prevent the strat where people go into the corner and not get damaged

Happy breaching !
- AcidRain

notes.title: Early Access Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Major Changes:
• Weapon selection UI was now revamped to be more user-friendly
https://i.ibb.co/54yGLZR/Weapon-UI.png

• Tooltips can be seen when hovering some icons for extra information
https://i.ibb.co/P14v12S/Tooltip.png

Minor Changes:
• Added multiplier text and changed active item UI
• Added active item energy cost right beside the model
• Fixed and rebalanced difficulty be lowering enemies initial health and speed
• Fixed hitbox of out of bounds reducing bugs related to falling
• Changed hitbox of enemies to accurately represent enemy model
• Lowered the drop rate for upgrade and unlock tokens
• Lower enemy limit rate 100 -> 75
• Reverted bullet status code for performance
• Much stable movement code to prevent clipping
• Balanced homing circle speed
• Added upgrade tokens limit UI
• Changed some weapon's names
• Slightly readjusted cursor to be more accurate
• Fixed a bug where Uria's token exceeds 100 

Happy breaching !
- AcidRain

notes.title: Early Access Version 1.1
notes.notes:
• Added a new item: Overheat - grants 5% chance for enemies to explode

https://i.ibb.co/5GckLwR/Item-Photo-PDN.png

• Added a new shop: Xol's shop - quick trades for the cost of energy (Press C to open)

https://i.ibb.co/Cw7TyR6/Xol-s-Shop.png

• Added new shop sounds to simulate a convenience store
• Enemy spawn limit increased (75 -> 100) and enemy health multiplier increased (0.025 -> 0.03)
• Nerfed discount item (15% -> 5%)
• Nerfed assault rifle's damage for they are quite overpowered
• Buffed repeater/minigun weapon's damage
• Fixed initial status chance not applying to weapon
• Fixed bug where game freezes when choosing the gun "Scorpio"
• Renamed a few items 

Happy breaching !
- AcidRain
